verdict.rationale: The only event-driven capability in the evidence is Adyen's webhooks, which push notifications on asynchronous status changes so you don't have to poll. Acting on those events still requires your own server code. The Agentic Cart API's optional cancel/commit session callbacks (e.g., releasing inventory when a shopper abandons checkout) are integration hooks, not user-defined rules. missing for 10: a user-configurable rules engine (condition → action), automatic action execution on events without custom code, documentation of rule authoring/management, and independent corroboration.
